wheaton-bible-church-il.assessment: Wheaton Bible Church is a significant evangelical church in the western Chicago suburbs. Hanibal Rodriguez became senior pastor in October 2021 after the previous pastor of 30+ years retired. Rodriguez originally led the Spanish congregation before being called to lead both congregations — a notable choice that signals multicultural ministry vision. Covenant Theological Seminary (PCA) training indicates solid Reformed evangelical foundation. ECFA accreditation signals financial accountability. Located in Wheaton, IL — the epicenter of American evangelicalism (Wheaton College, etc.). Strong prospect.

white-oak-arp-senoia-ga.assessment: ARP congregation in rural Georgia, Cumberland Valley Presbytery. Westminster Standards, male-only elders/deacons, Seceder-Presbyterian heritage from the Erskines.

score_notes.christology: ARP affirms Nicene orthodoxy — Christ fully God and fully man, sole mediator.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Standards affirmed — Scripture inerrant, infallible, sufficient.
score_notes.gender: Male-only teaching and ruling elders per ARP Form of Government. Male-only clergy.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders with ARP Synod/presbytery accountability; historic Scots-Irish Presbyterian polity.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformation soteriology — Westminster Confession articulation of sola fide/sola gratia/solus Christus.
score_notes.cultural: Conservative Southern Presbyterian heritage; resistant to progressive theology; historic commitments intact.
score_notes.preaching: Expository preaching from the whole counsel of God; traditional Presbyterian homiletic.
score_notes.mission: Great Commission and covenantal Reformed evangelism; Erskine heritage of missions.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Varies by congregation; historic ARP emphasizes household-led discipleship.
score_notes.denominational: ARP (Associate Reformed Presbyterian) — conservative Southern Presbyterian denomination with Erskine College/Seminary heritage and male-only officers.

whitesburg-baptist-church-huntsville-sbc.assessment: Whitesburg Baptist Church is a large SBC megachurch in Huntsville, AL led by Darryl Craft. Former pastor Dr. Jimmy Jackson led for 40 years. SBC affiliation confirmed.

score_notes.christology: SBC church — affirms orthodox Christology (Nicene, Chalcedonian).
score_notes.scripture: SBC — Baptist Faith & Message 2000 affirms inerrancy and authority of Scripture.
score_notes.gender: Complementarian — SBC standard (CBMW halfway position; MOOP holds patriarchal headship as the biblical standard). Male senior pastor confirmed; verify whether headship convictions are robust or drifting toward functional egalitarianism.
score_notes.leadership: Dr. Jimmy Jackson as Senior Pastor. Established, stable leadership.
score_notes.soteriology: SBC — salvation by grace through faith. BF&M 2000 framework.
score_notes.cultural: No CRT/DEI/social justice language on homepage; mission framed as 'encounter Jesus and experience life change.' SBC + BF&M 2000 baseline + men's ministry — sufficient to flip green.
score_notes.preaching: Verify style. R29: Biblical Counseling ministry listed — suggests scripture-centered approach.
score_notes.mission: Active church — Equip Groups, live streaming. R29: mission 'to help people encounter Jesus and experience life change'.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: R29 confirmed: dedicated Men ministry in navigation plus Life Groups, Equip Groups, and D-Groups for all ages.
score_notes.denominational: Southern Baptist Convention — cooperative accountability through state conventions and associations.
